result.analyst_notes: Mission-led and customer-first, with the stated mission the only explicit value. Most text is factual business description: revenue, headcount and brands. Voice is first-person plural (Our mission, We help). Commitments are absolute and aspirational, with no hedging. Stakeholders beyond customers receive little attention.
